mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_attempt (user_id, client_ip, fail_count, lock_until, last_failed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clientIp}, 0, NULL, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), client_ip = VALUES(client_ip)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, client_ip AS clientIp, fail_count AS failCount, lock_until AS lockUntil, last_failed_at AS lastFailedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM login_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_ip = #{clientIp}

SELECT user_id AS userId, client_ip AS clientIp, fail_count AS failCount, lock_until AS lockUntil, last_failed_at AS lastFailedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM login_attempt WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_ip = #{clientIp} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE login_attempt SET fail_count = #{failCount}, lock_until = #{lockUntil}, last_failed_at = #{lastFailedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND client_ip = #{clientIp}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM login_attempt WHERE updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
